verdict_msg: HARD_FAIL: under CORRELATED/SYSTEMATIC source errors (shared per-item decoy for every erring source), the independent channel is FOOLED. auc_unrel(correlated)=0.3240 (<= 0.55 collapse-ceiling: True; band was (0.55, 0.9) under independent-random errors). mean_delta_hard_unrel(correlated)=-0.0975 (<= 0.02 ties/hurts: True). mean_score_correct_unrel=0.6715 vs mean_score_incorrect_unrel=0.7038 (atom 29376's independent-random arm here: 0.2929 vs 0.1591 -- reproduction confirms correct>incorrect gap present under independent errors). Gate D held (reimplementation verified: auc_unrel(ir)=0.6733, mean_delta_hard_unrel(ir)=0.0610), so this is a real scope limit, not an artifact: the CG (atom 29376) is honestly BOUNDED to independent-random source errors. Correlated/systematic errors (common-mode bias across raters/sources) break the same-item-consistency raw ingredient the channel is built on -- confidently-wrong sources that agree with each other on an item look identical to genuinely-correct sources to a peer-consistency estimator, exactly the failure mode the brain_check (Kalman/Ernst&Banks independent-noise assumption) predicts when that assumption is violated. Record as a real, informative scope bound; do NOT force-pass.
